items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: But on this particular show we did -- I did, just with her, 'If I Had a Ribbon Bow.'

ctx.x: I could do without the strings, believe you me, I can do without a lot of background. I feel very, very restricted, you know, when it comes to large arrangements, anything that's arranged, you know -- boom, boom, boom.
What if somebody said -- well, I won't prejudge the issue. Remember when you were on that Women in Jazz concerts, they had the woman who plays the harp, Corky Hale, did you hear her when she played?
I don't think I was there when she played.
